Feature Description: Provide users a fast and reliable way to book rides or become drivers on-demand.
Implementation Details: The platform provides an on-demand mobility service that matches riders with nearby drivers. Registration is fast, and active ride bookings complete reliably.

Feature Description: Enable users to switch between customer and driver roles via a button within the app.
Implementation Details: The mobile app includes a quick role toggle button that allows a single user account to act as either a passenger or driver depending on active mode selection.

Feature Description: Match ride requests efficiently and minimise wait times for both drivers and customers.
Implementation Details: An automated dispatch engine filters available drivers in a radius to match bookings quickly and keep driver wait times low.

Feature Description: Ensure safe and traceable trips with ratings and trip records for both customers and drivers.
Implementation Details: The system logs trip records and coordinates securely, allowing riders and drivers to rate each other and review completed trip details.

Feature Description: Allow operations to monitor the platform centrally via the Admin Panel.
Implementation Details: A central admin panel allows operators to oversee active rides, verify drivers, manage accounts, and monitor metrics.

Feature Description: Support multiple payment methods (cash, digital wallet, credit/debit cards) through PayHere.
Implementation Details: The platform supports digital payments through PayHere, in-app wallet balances, and direct cash payments at trip completion.

Feature Description: Integrate Google Maps API for accurate location tracking, routing, and real-time ETA updates.
Implementation Details: Map APIs are fully integrated to display maps, search addresses, calculate turn-by-turn route paths, and estimate real-time arrivals.

Feature Description: Use Firebase for push notifications for ride status updates, promotions, and other relevant alerts.
Implementation Details: The notification system triggers push alerts for booking confirmations, driver arrivals, and promotional alerts.

Feature Description: Offer multi-service delivery (food, market, parcel Flash, basic truck) from a single app.
Implementation Details: The single super-app vertical supports ride-hailing, package deliveries, grocery shopping, restaurant orders, and moving trucks.

Feature Description: Drive repeat use through a simple loyalty points system and promo codes.
Implementation Details: Promos and checkout loyalty point rules drive user engagement by calculating and applying discounts to orders.

Feature Description: Support basic business accounts for corporate ride and delivery bookings.
Implementation Details: Corporate profile configuration enables businesses to link employee profiles and charge bookings directly to company expense accounts.

Feature Description: Surface third-party events to increase engagement.
Implementation Details: An event catalog allows users to discover local experiences and purchase tickets inside the mobile app.

Feature Description: User registration (phone number + OTP, email/password)
Implementation Details: Users can register and sign in seamlessly on the mobile app using their phone number and a one-time verification code, while administrators access their accounts using a traditional phone and password setup. Static login and sign-up previews are also hosted on the website pages.

Feature Description: Profile management (name, photo, contact details, saved places)
Implementation Details: Profile details, profile pictures, and contact information are fully editable in the mobile app, with changes saving securely to the database. Users can save frequent destinations like home and work, and administrators can view and manage these profiles from the admin panel dashboard.

Feature Description: Ability to switch between Passenger Mode and Driver Mode using a button in the app.
Implementation Details: Users can toggle between passenger and driver modes with a single tap in the mobile app. The system handles active role validation automatically behind the scenes to show the appropriate screens and menus.

Feature Description: Set pickup and drop-off locations via GPS or map pin (integrating Google Maps API).
Implementation Details: Passengers can select their pickup and drop-off locations by dragging a map pin or searching for addresses via GPS. Real-time driver positions plot on the admin live monitoring map, while the website displays a coverage map of active service zones.

Feature Description: Choose vehicle type (for passengers) and view fare estimate.
Implementation Details: Passengers can select their preferred vehicle class and see upfront fare estimates calculated from the current distance and traffic. The website homepage also features an interactive fare estimator to give prospective users pricing estimates.

Feature Description: View upfront fare estimate and confirm ride booking (for customers).
Implementation Details: Fare estimates are displayed upfront before a passenger confirms their booking. Once confirmed, the system initiates the driver-matching sequence while keeping the user informed of the estimated arrival time.

Feature Description: Request a ride and match with the nearest available driver (for customers).
Implementation Details: The matching engine searches a three-kilometer radius to find the closest online driver and dispatch the ride request. Both passengers and admins can monitor the booking status and driver progress in real time.

Feature Description: Turn on/off availability (for drivers).
Implementation Details: Drivers can control when they want to work by flipping an online switch in the app. Their online status updates instantly in the database and is visible on the operations dashboard.

Feature Description: Accept or reject incoming ride requests (for drivers).
Implementation Details: Incoming booking requests appear as slide-up notifications on the driver's screen, allowing them to accept or decline the job. The matching server processes their decision and updates the passenger's screen immediately.

Feature Description: GPS navigation for pickups and drop-offs using Google Maps API, with turn-by-turn directions, picture-in-picture mini-map, speed display, mute, and incident reporting (for drivers).
Implementation Details: Incident reporting is fully integrated for driver safety, and active routes update live on the passenger tracking screen. However, turn-by-turn navigation, picture-in-picture maps, and speedometers are still in development.

Feature Description: Collect payment (cash, card, or wallet) and confirm payment (for drivers).
Implementation Details: The app prompts drivers with a payment summary card upon ending a trip to collect fares. Payments are logged securely in the system ledgers to keep cash and digital transactions balanced.

Feature Description: Payment processing via PayHere, supporting cash, card, and wallet for customers and drivers.
Implementation Details: Digital payments process smoothly using the PayHere gateway, supporting credit cards, debit cards, and in-app wallets. Users can review payment options on the website help pages, and admins can audit transactions from their panel.

Feature Description: View earnings and trip history (for drivers).
Implementation Details: Drivers can track their daily and weekly earnings summaries and review completed trips inside the app. The website drive page also includes an earnings calculator, and admins can manage withdrawals from the payout dashboard.

Feature Description: In-app communication (call) with the other party (passenger or driver).
Implementation Details: Passengers and drivers can call each other directly from the active booking screen using a secure dialer launcher. Support hotlines are also listed on the website contact page for quick assistance.

Feature Description: Rate and review the other party after the trip.
Implementation Details: Both passengers and drivers can rate their experience and leave text feedback after completing a ride. These reviews help maintain high service standards and are visible on admin dashboard profiles.

Feature Description: View trip history and receipts (for both customers and drivers).
Implementation Details: Customers and drivers can view their historical bookings list and access detailed digital receipts inside the app. Admins can search and export all system booking records when resolving disputes.

Feature Description: Emergency SOS button and share trip with contacts.
Implementation Details: The app features a panic button that instantly logs an emergency status to the database, notifying the safety team. Users can also share their live trip tracking token with family or friends.

Feature Description: Receive push notifications via Firebase for booking status, driver arrival, promotions, and updates.
Implementation Details: Firebase push alerts notify users instantly about driver arrivals, booking confirmations, and promotional campaigns. Admins can send targeted notification campaigns to all active users.

Feature Description: Multi-stop trips – add up to two intermediate stops with a configurable waiting allowance per stop (exceeding it triggers standard waiting charges).
Implementation Details: The backend database fully supports multi-stop itineraries and waiting allowances; however, the "Add Stop" button in the customer app is currently disabled in the search interface.

Feature Description: One-way or return-trip selection at booking.
Implementation Details: Users can choose between one-way bookings or round trips in the destination search menu. Round trips apply a discounted return fare multiplier, and the feature's guidelines are listed on the website ride page.

Feature Description: Instant booking (Now) or scheduled booking (Later) with date and time picker.
Implementation Details: Customers can request an immediate ride or schedule one for a future date and time. Background schedulers manage these bookings and dispatch them automatically when the time arrives.

Feature Description: Add note to driver and apply promo code at booking.
Implementation Details: Passengers can apply coupon codes at checkout and add custom notes for their driver, such as specific gate codes or directions.

Feature Description: Saved Addresses with Home and Work shortcuts.
Implementation Details: Users can save frequently used addresses as shortcuts like Home and Work inside the location search screen for faster bookings.

Feature Description: Help & Support flow with last-five activity quick-access and category routing (Account & payment, App issues, Using Ziggo Rides).
Implementation Details: Interactive categories and chat screens live in the mobile app support modules. The website faq models help channels, and support tickets route to the admin panel.

Feature Description: Notifications inbox with system, ride, and promotional alerts.
Implementation Details: A dedicated notification inbox inside the mobile app displays system messages, booking status updates, and customized promotions.

Feature Description: Activity history filtered by service category – Rides, Trucks, Food, Rentals, Delivery, Market, Courier, Events – with Ongoing, Completed, Complaint, and Cancelled tabs.
Implementation Details: Users can filter their activity history by service types—such as Rides, Food, Mart, and Flash—and sort them into ongoing, completed, and canceled tabs.

Feature Description: Camera permission flow for in-app QR scanning (basic Scan & Pay).
Implementation Details: The mobile app uses camera permissions to let customers scan QR codes at checkout for quick payments.

Feature Description: Basic business account: add a corporate profile for business-billed bookings.
Implementation Details: Users can create corporate profiles to charge business bookings directly to their company account. The website describes corporate billing dashboards and registration forms. Admins manage companies in corporate settings.

Feature Description: About Us and app version display under the account menu.
Implementation Details: Version details display on mobile app settings pages and are detailed on the website about page.

Feature Description: Invite a Friend referral flow from the Earn-with-Ziggo screen.
Implementation Details: Database tables contain structure for referral bonuses, but the invite system is not yet active on the backend or the mobile app screens.

Feature Description: ETA sharing – user can share their real-time estimated time of arrival with selected contacts directly from the active trip screen.
Implementation Details: Passengers can share their real-time estimated arrival time with contacts via a link that opens in a public tracking webpage.

Feature Description: Account deletion – user can permanently delete their Ziggo account from within the app settings, with a confirmation step and data-erasure notice.
Implementation Details: Users can permanently delete their accounts from the settings page, which scrubs their personal details from the database while keeping anonymized records for audits.

Feature Description: Automated complaint responses – minor and routine support complaints receive instant automated responses, with escalation to a live agent for complex issues.
Implementation Details: The customer support system uses automated rules to send instant replies to common complaints, such as minor fare disputes, before routing complex issues to live agents.

Feature Description: Simple profile completeness indicator – shows the user how complete their profile is and prompts them to fill missing fields.
Implementation Details: The app calculates and shows a profile completeness bar under the settings menu to encourage users to finish adding their photo and contact details.

Feature Description: Secure admin login with role-based access control.
Implementation Details: Admin role checks are validated by backend auth servers and React login pages.

Feature Description: Dashboard showing active trips, online users, revenue, etc.
Implementation Details: Real-time graphs show active trips, online drivers, and revenue figures.

Feature Description: Manage customer/driver accounts (approve, suspend, delete).
Implementation Details: Admins can approve, suspend, or delete customer and driver accounts.

Feature Description: Configure fare rules, promo codes, and discounts.
Implementation Details: Admins can edit fare rules, base rates, and active discount campaigns.

Feature Description: View and monitor all trips, including customer and driver actions.
Implementation Details: A live tracking map lets operations monitor active vehicles and requests.

Feature Description: Manage complaints, disputes, and refunds.
Implementation Details: Admins can review complaints, process passenger refunds, and respond to support tickets.

Feature Description: Reports and analytics for trips, revenue, driver performance.
Implementation Details: Analytical reports show monthly breakdowns of trips, driver performance, and overall revenue.

Feature Description: Manage commissions and driver payouts.
Implementation Details: Payout views let admins calculate commissions, manage payouts, and review driver withdrawals.

Feature Description: Manage merchant partners (restaurants, market vendors).
Implementation Details: Admins can approve restaurant registrations and manage mart vendor listings.

Feature Description: Configure delivery categories and merchant onboarding rules.
Implementation Details: Onboarding rules and delivery categories configure inside the categories dashboard.

Feature Description: Manage event listings.
Implementation Details: Admins can publish and update local event tickets on the events page.

Feature Description: Manage basic business accounts (corporate billing).
Implementation Details: Operations can monitor company billing, members, and credit lines in corporate settings.

Feature Description: Configure loyalty points earning rate and redemption rules.
Implementation Details: System loyalty points accrual and burn values are adjustable under admin settings.

Feature Description: Authentication and authorisation for all user roles (token-based).
Implementation Details: JWT token logins verify customer, driver, and admin sessions on the backend.

Feature Description: Ride-matching engine – locate nearest available drivers and dispatch.
Implementation Details: Location filters dispatch bookings to the closest driver on the matching service.

Feature Description: Real-time location tracking and updates for drivers and trips using Google Maps API.
Implementation Details: Live positions stream via websockets to update customer maps and admin tracking views.

Feature Description: Fare calculation engine – distance, time, vehicle type, surge.
Implementation Details: The fare engine computes booking totals based on base rates, distance, travel time, and active surge multipliers.

Feature Description: Payment processing and wallet management through PayHere API; basic QR payment rail.
Implementation Details: Transaction ledgers record wallet updates and PayHere payment gateway completions.

Feature Description: Trip lifecycle management (requested → accepted → ongoing → completed/cancelled).
Implementation Details: The booking service manages ride states from request to arrival and completion.

Feature Description: Notifications service via Firebase for push alerts (booking status, driver arrival, promotions).
Implementation Details: Notifications dispatch push alerts to device tokens upon status changes.

Feature Description: Ratings and reviews storage and aggregation.
Implementation Details: Customer feedback scores compile and save under driver rating logs.

Feature Description: Commission and payout calculation.
Implementation Details: Commission deductions execute automatically when a driver completes a trip.

Feature Description: Data storage for users, trips, vehicles, transactions, merchants, events.
Implementation Details: The database stores structured records for users, trips, transactions, merchants, and events.

Feature Description: APIs consumed by Customer/Driver App and Admin Panel.
Implementation Details: Secure REST APIs serve all endpoints requested by client apps and admin panels.

Feature Description: Logging, audit trail, and error handling.
Implementation Details: Server frameworks log error messages and query traces to standard output streams.

Feature Description: Simple loyalty engine – points accrual per transaction and redemption at checkout.
Implementation Details: The loyalty service manages earning rules, balance updates, and checkout discounts.

Feature Description: Merchant order routing – accept, prepare, dispatch lifecycle for food and market orders.
Implementation Details: Restaurant order statuses update through pending, preparing, and delivered flows.

Feature Description: Basic courier dispatch for deliveries beyond Flash range.
Implementation Details: Distance thresholds route delivery requests to weight-based tiers.

Feature Description: Multi-stop trip routing and waiting-charge calculation.
Implementation Details: Fare algorithms compute coordinate offsets and wait times for multi-stop bookings.

Feature Description: Promotions engine – promo codes, validity windows, usage limits, eligibility rules.
Implementation Details: Coupon systems verify eligibility conditions and active windows during checkout.

Feature Description: Basic event catalogue service with category and search.
Implementation Details: Event catalog APIs query search terms and ticketholder lists.

Feature Description: Basic business-account engine for corporate billing.
Implementation Details: Booking fares are automatically debited from linked corporate account lines if selected.

Feature Description: A user can only be in one active role (passenger or driver) at a time.
Implementation Details: Endpoints verify role sessions so users can only perform driver tasks while active in driver mode.

Feature Description: Fare calculation includes base fare, distance, time, and surge pricing adjustments.
Implementation Details: Fare calculation logic computes booking totals using base rates, distance, time, and dynamic surge multipliers.

Feature Description: Cancellation after a grace period may incur a cancellation fee.
Implementation Details: Cancellation grace windows are listed on the website terms, but backend systems do not charge fees or penalties for late cancellations.

Feature Description: Users must be document-verified and admin-approved to operate as drivers.
Implementation Details: Drivers must upload valid documents and receive admin approval before they can go online.

Feature Description: Platform commission is deducted before the driver’s payout.
Implementation Details: Platform commissions are offset from driver balances upon trip completion.

Feature Description: Loyalty points accrue on qualifying spend; refunded/cancelled transactions reverse the accrual.
Implementation Details: Loyalty points accrue on completed bookings and reverse if bookings cancel.

Feature Description: Flash parcel delivery is same-day; basic courier handles longer distances.
Implementation Details: Courier bookings route weight-based packages, while Flash handles small, local items.

Feature Description: Basic truck delivery is for moving goods within the service area; no size-tier categories or goods insurance.
Implementation Details: Moving bookings default to standard Lorry sizes with fixed base fares.

Feature Description: Multi-stop trips allow a configurable per-stop waiting allowance (default 2 minutes); excess time is billed at standard waiting rates.
Implementation Details: Stop wait delays past two minutes calculate waiting surcharges upon booking completions.

Feature Description: Basic membership benefits apply only while the membership is active.
Implementation Details: Loyalty discount rules verify subscription validity periods at checkout.

Feature Description: Promo codes have defined validity windows and per-user usage limits enforced by the promotions engine.
Implementation Details: Coupon systems verify database records to prevent duplicate promo code uses.

Feature Description: Food Delivery - Order meals from 10,000+ local restaurants
Implementation Details: Users can browse restaurants and order meals for home delivery. Website details local dining options, and admins manage merchant listings.

Feature Description: Merchant Admin - Restaurant Menu and Order manager
Implementation Details: Restaurant partners can manage their menu items and track active orders.

Feature Description: Mart Grocery - Local groceries, dark stores & pharmacy products
Implementation Details: Users can order groceries, dark store supplies, and pharmacy products inside the mart menu.

Feature Description: Mart Vendor - Store catalog stock and product manager
Implementation Details: Stores can manage their inventory lists and product catalog details.

Feature Description: Parcel Flash - Same-day courier deliveries (Document/S/M/L)
Implementation Details: Same-day delivery checkouts are completed on the mobile app, and size rules are listed on the website.

Feature Description: Truck Mover - Moving Lorries with 1-3 helpers option + insurance
Implementation Details: Lorry options with helper choices select on mobile app checkout panels.

Feature Description: Gold Pass - Subscriptions offering free delivery (LKR 549/mo)
Implementation Details: Gold subscription plans are processed in Flutter and backend models. Subscription checkout is in the app, and promos are on the website.

Feature Description: QR Scan & Go - Pay local merchants/drivers via scan codes
Implementation Details: QR scanners and payments verify on mobile app screens.

Feature Description: Incentives - Driver quest incentives milestones
Implementation Details: Milestones trackers load on mobile app driver earnings pages.

Feature Description: Corporate accounts - Ziggo for Business billing & Cost Centers
Implementation Details: Invoicing billing profiles link to corporate routes on mobile apps, website, and admin dashboards.

Feature Description: Admin CRUD - Central Superadmin user management controls
Implementation Details: Access controls for admins and roles edit in admin templates and backend routes.

Feature Description: Female-Driver Option - Feasibility study / option to match female riders with female drivers.
Implementation Details: Feasibility studies are completed. Database migrations add gender columns to user profiles, and the customer profile allows gender updates on the mobile app. Matching filters are not yet implemented.
